To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) sequence-based identification is a very time-consuming task; (ii) sequence-based identification of the majority of the fungal species that we examined was wrong, even when the top BLAST score was very high; and (iii) the number of misidentified sequences is so high that sequence-based identification cannot be considered as a valid alternative to morphological identification.
